### Haggai and Zechariah Encourage the People
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/haggai-and-zechariah-encourage-people
Passage: Ezra 5:1-2
Points:
- Rebuilding the temple had ceased for over a decade due to persistent local hostility.
- God sent the prophets Haggai and Zechariah to stir up and encourage the Jewish leaders to restart the work.
- When Persian officials questioned their authorization, the builders continued working while an inquiry was sent to Darius.
- The community persevered because God's watchful eye was actively shielding and sustaining them.
- Modern believers can move forward in their calling knowing God will faithfully protect them until His purpose is fulfilled.

### Divinely Empowered for Our Greatest Challenges
Author: Jennifer Slattery
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/divinely-empowered-for-our-greatest-challenges-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Ezra 5:5
Points:
- Faithful obedience and spiritual restoration will almost always encounter opposition and intimidation.
- The returned exiles were not halted because the watchful eye and favor of God rested upon them.
- Whenever God assigns a task, He provides all the necessary strength and resources to complete it.
- Difficulties present a choice to either cower in fear or trust in God's sovereign care.
- Believers can find courage knowing Christ has overcome every hardship and empowers His people to endure.
